title: Table polish: market above the stalls, event card drawn, tomorrow walks in at night, stall sales recap, Market Day intro
problem: Owner requests for the game table: layout order, the event card's opening, the night hand-over of customers, a recap of who sold what, and a first Market Day explanation.
scope: Wholesale market board above the stall row (swapped)
Tapping today's event draws the card like a card from a deck; once shown, a translucent backdrop instead of white
At night, tomorrow's customer cards move into today's customer slots in step with the fruit ageing
On the takings screen, tap any stall (yours or a rival's) to see its sales: which fruit, to which customer, at what price; the same card style
A first-time pop-up on the first Market Day: what is different, which cards there are, what can be built
exclusions: No rule, balance or save change; nothing secret is shown before the rules make it public (sales are public after the rush)
